authorization: 进入研究诊断状态，认真复盘整个研究过程，尽力寻找新的突破口。
scope: One existing-evidence, zero-fit diagnostic contrast; does not renew account/model quotas or authorize phase advance
motivation: EX035 report explicitly left historical opportunity clustering versus subsequent participation value untested; EX034/35 already established material single-exit/account-action ordering differences
question: At an existing C0011 holding decision, does strictly past additional opportunity density distinguish extending the current holding from selling and resuming the original strategy?

sample.population: All previously saved EX035 decision nodes, not selected using future return, matching exact cycle/entry/decision dates
sample.original_policy: Published EX035 C9000 no-intervention equivalent to original C0011, not C0056
sample.existing_clusters: Use saved EX035 connected D-through-E9 cluster_id; expected original count 59

exposure.definition: Published original ready AND parent AND high eligibility, strictly preceding six pinned stock sessions, minus the verified triggering signal of the current position
exposure.window_choice: Six sessions span two H3 holding lengths; not two complete entry/exit/reentry cycles, no window scan
exposure.interpretation: Past opportunity density, including signals before the current entry; not actually missed future orders or an independent market source

outcomes.primary: Existing A9=(H9-X9)/W_D: extend current holding then resume original policy versus original sale then original policy, at fixed E9 close
outcomes.decomposition: Existing L9=(H9-C9)/W_D and O9=(X9-C9)/W_D; verify A9=L9-O9
outcomes.frozen_terminal: Existing E9 and existing W_D denominator, no newly generated returns or forced liquidation
outcomes.units: Decimal local wealth differences; report percentage points, never annualized or summed into account returns

expected_directions.L9: No required direction; report to distinguish general stock participation from relative action value
expected_directions.interpretation: A larger O9 without lower A9 does not support the proposed relative-action mechanism; no reversal after results

fixed_analysis.raw: Same all-node sample for both groups and all three existing outcomes
fixed_analysis.known_states: P = published P_value > 0 and D = published D_value > 0; verify from decision-day entry/close/previous-close fields, zero in nonpositive state
fixed_analysis.common_support: decision_year x P x D; retain only strata with at least one node per exposure group; weight each stratum difference by min(n_none,n_extra). Record every sparse or excluded stratum and coverage; do not merge strata or fit controls
fixed_analysis.without_2026: Decision date and saved terminal_date both <=2025-12-31
fixed_analysis.annual: All seven decision years; not annual account acceptance, missing group returns null
fixed_analysis.cluster_equal: Within each exposure group first average that group's nodes inside each original cluster, then average its observed clusters equally; report each group's observed cluster count, not a fully paired-cluster contrast
fixed_analysis.leave_one_cluster_out: Delete each original cluster in turn, never select favorable deletion
fixed_analysis.bootstrap: 2000 draws seed 13 of whole original clusters with replacement; same cluster multiplicity for both groups and all rows; preserve null when a group absent, report valid replicate count, no resampling replacements
fixed_analysis.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of valid descriptive replicates, not an economic hard gate or future success probability

decision_logic: Evidence of lower A9 in extra-opportunity nodes can justify reviewing predictive decision-use research; alone does not establish causality or a trade rule
If lower A9 disappears under known-state/common-support or concentration views, retain competing explanation rather than claiming new information
If primary direction not supported, do not scan another window, flip the hypothesis, change terminal, or substitute an O9-only success claim
Feasibility/support insufficiency is distinct from ineffectiveness; no missing row filled with zero
Any result remains local to original C0011 policy; actual C0056 improvement and original yearly economic goals remain unanswered
prohibited: Future reentry or payoff as a feature
